title: Gaji Namul (Korean Seasoned Aubergine)
summary: Slender aubergines steamed until just tender, cooled, torn into strips and tossed with a soy, sesame oil, garlic, spring onion and chilli-flake dressing, finished with sesame seeds.
equipment: steamer basket set over a pan with lid

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Bring 5 cm of water to the boil under the steamer. Steam the aubergine pieces, skin side down, for 4-5 min until soft but still holding their shape; overcooked pieces turn mushy when torn. Spread on a plate to cool for 10 min.

steps.title: Tear
steps.text: Pull each piece lengthwise into finger-width strips.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Stir together the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, spring onion, sugar and chilli flakes in the bowl. Add the aubergine and toss gently by hand until coated. Scatter with sesame seeds and pepper and serve at room temperature or chilled.

tips: Choose slim, glossy aubergines without soft spots.
Leave out the chilli flakes for a milder banchan.
Serve with rice and a few other banchan, or alongside grilled meat.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; the flavour deepens overnight. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
